messages.也可以直接在下方聊天框回答。: You can also answer directly in the chat below.
messages.继续提问，或告诉 EnGenie 想怎样调整任务…: Ask another question or tell EnGenie how to adjust the task…
messages.可以直接提问；只有要求创建或修改任务时才生成新方案。: Ask questions directly; a new plan is generated only when you request a task or a change.
messages.Teams频道工作流的HTTP触发链接: Teams channel workflow HTTP trigger URL
messages.通过邮件还是Teams频道发送？: Send by email or to a Teams channel?
messages.报告发送已暂停，等待确认发送设置。: Report delivery is paused pending confirmation of the delivery settings.
messages.报告设置已保存，可按需发送。: Report settings saved; send on demand.
messages.报告已启用，按独立发送计划运行。: Report enabled with its own delivery schedule.
messages.报告已启用，采集成功后发送（原有设置）。: Report enabled; send after successful collection (legacy setting).
messages.报告发送计划当前未启用，请补充发送设置并确认。: Report scheduling is not enabled. Complete and confirm the delivery settings.
messages.发送设置尚未齐全：请在聊天中提供Teams频道工作流链接。: Delivery settings are incomplete. Provide the Teams channel workflow URL in the chat.
messages.发送设置尚未齐全：请在聊天中补充对应类型的工作流和收件信息。: Delivery settings are incomplete. Provide the matching workflow and recipient details in the chat.
messages.报告预览已就绪。确认数据范围、处理规则和独立发送计划，也可先发送一次测试。: Report preview is ready. Review the data range, processing rules and independent delivery schedule, or send a test first.
messages.发送设置可直接在聊天框提供；缺少信息时 EnGenie 会提问。发送测试仅发送一: Provide delivery settings in the chat; EnGenie will ask for missing details. A test sends once and does not enable scheduled delivery. Check email, Teams or the workflow run history after the request is accepted.
messages.预览使用当前已有数据；发送时会重新计算选定日期范围。: The preview uses currently saved data; the selected date range is recalculated at delivery time.
messages.目标日期范围目前暂无数据；可确认规则，发送时将重新读取已保存的数据。: The selected date range has no data yet. You can confirm the rules; saved data will be read again at delivery time.
messages.告诉 EnGenie 报告的数据范围、处理方式和发送时间…: Tell EnGenie the report data range, processing rules and delivery time…
